say:1:1310309001:0.text: You're here for the festival too, right? Oh look! Chippy's waking up!
say:1:1310309001:0.source_cn: 你们也是来参加祭典的吧……哎呀，满满，你总算醒了。

say:3:1310309002:0.text: Lorsan, you really scared Chippy just now! You looked...
say:3:1310309002:0.source_cn: 洛桑，你刚才也太吓人了吧！我还以为你……

say:4:1310309003:0.text: Sorry, sorry! Um... please, just don't tell Lyca about this. She'll totally yank my ears!
say:4:1310309003:0.source_cn: 抱歉抱歉。那个……拜托了，可千万别把这件事告诉莱卡，不...

say:5:1310309004:1.text: What are you doing here, playing pranks and scaring people?
say:5:1310309004:1.source_cn: 你怎么会在这里恶作剧吓唬别人？

say:6:1310309005:0.text: Oh, well, I sent you a letter about heading north! And I heard some merchants raving about this famous festival, so I figured I'd check it out.
say:6:1310309005:0.source_cn: 我之前给你们写过信说要来北方游历呀！我在路上听到一些商...

say:7:1310309006:0.text: Aaand... I kind of needed some money, so... now I'm working for this lovely innkeeper! Gotta fund the adventure somehow!
say:7:1310309006:0.source_cn: 至于刚才嘛……我只是在给这位美丽的老板娘打工而已，毕竟...

say:10:1310309007:1.text: Oh my, did we scare you? Wasn't that a thrill? We planned this little act for the Ghostly Getaway to start things off with a bit of a bang.
say:10:1310309007:1.source_cn: 哈哈，这位客人被吓到了吗？是不是很刺激？这可是我们为了...

say:11:1310309008:1.text: It looks like it worked... but don't worry too much, darling. A festival needs a little excitement to really come to life.
say:11:1310309008:1.source_cn: 看来还是挺有效果……啊，抱歉抱歉，不要介意哦。祭典嘛，...

say:12:1310309009:1.text: It wasn't scary at all! Chippy just, um, wasn't ready for it!
say:12:1310309009:1.source_cn: 其实……一点也不可怕！嗯，满满刚才只是没准备好……

choice_prompt:13:1310309009.text: It wasn't scary at all! Chippy just, um, wasn't ready for it!
choice_prompt:13:1310309009.source_cn: 其实……一点也不可怕！嗯，满满刚才只是没准备好……

say:14:1310309010:1.text: What you felt just now? That was just a "tease", a mere appetizer. The real fun is about to begin.
say:14:1310309010:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，刚才的只能算是个“小惊吓”，一盘开胃前菜而已。

say:15:1310309011:1.text: Oh dear, I never properly introduced myself. I'm Gerda, the owner of this lovely place. Pleased to meet you!
say:15:1310309011:1.source_cn: 忘了自我介绍，我是这里的老板娘格尔达。

say:18:1310309012:1.text: Madam Gerda, I was wondering why this inn is called the Frozen Paw.
say:18:1310309012:1.source_cn: 咦，格尔达女士，为什么这家店的名字要叫“白熊温泉旅店”呢？

say:19:1310309013:1.text: Hahaha... Because my best friend has lovely white paws, and she would get ice on them when winter came. Unfortunately, she prefers the comforts of our village too much to move to Cedartown.
say:19:1310309013:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，亲爱的，因为我最好的朋友是位可爱的白熊女士。可...

say:20:1310309014:1.text: I understand now. You opened this inn in honor of her, right?
say:20:1310309014:1.source_cn: 我明白了！所以你就用她的名字在这里开了家旅店，对吧？

say:21:1310309015:1.text: That's right, darling. If you have the chance to visit my village, you'll find that my friend opened a shop called the Brown Paw Clothier. *Giggle* We're just like two peas in a pod.
say:21:1310309015:1.source_cn: 正是这样，亲爱的。要是你们有机会去我家乡一趟，就会发现...

say:22:1310309016:1.text: You two must have a special friendship!
say:22:1310309016:1.source_cn: 哇，真是令人羡慕的友情！

say:23:1310309017:1.text: Alright, everyone, come with me. What's next will really make your head spin!
say:23:1310309017:1.source_cn: 好啦，大家随我来吧，接下来的才是真正的大餐呢！

choice:13:0:1.text: So this is the Ghostly Getaway?
choice:13:0:1.male: So this is the Ghostly Getaway?
choice:13:0:1.female: So this is the Ghostly Getaway?
